hull_nose_clearance_setback.interpretation: Rearward offset of the leading hull vertex at source[108,310] to clear native track rivet heads after refining the front lower border. Source point and calibration remain unchanged; 6mm is approximately one pixel within the initial +/-3px uncertainty.

wheel_disk_radius.interpretation: Shared M1404 outside radius; independent of idler/drive tip diameters. Inferred from static common interface studies, not measured from perspective pixels.

wheel_rim_land_inner_radius.interpretation: Inferred idler attachment-land bore, chosen equal to the provisional drive bore at nominal dimensions; source does not dimension this idler surface.

wheel_rim_rivet_radius.interpretation: Common 24-hole attachment circle per rim/disk; independently owned shared interface, not an inset from idler OD.

drive_teeth.interpretation: Nominal working hypothesis follows two original 35-tooth assertions; 37 remains a separately printed conflicting ratio implication. Neither branch is a qualified operating gear.

drive_root_radius.interpretation: Inferred radial depth of circular reliefs; no involute or conjugate-profile claim.

drive_groove_radius.interpretation: Inferred circular relief radius between drive teeth.

drive_lip_inner_radius.interpretation: Inferred outboard rim cavity, clearing the shared disk radius while retaining an inboard riveted land.

drive_crest_radius.interpretation: Inferred radius on the two axial crest edges of each tooth; native rounding must remove material only.

hull_fuel_back_pixel_x.interpretation: Independent inferred longitudinal backplate station. Initial source-pixel equivalent 1630 caused two bearing and two rivet overlaps; candidate 1642 moves the continuous plate aft and extends its owned roof/floor edges. HB27 supports a continuous backplate but does not measure this station. Bounds support sensitivity trials, not historical accuracy or manufacturing tolerances.
